answer: Work slots stop clone farms with a basalt-hard rule: every agent burns a 30-unit deposit to claim one slot, forfeited if the slot sits idle or its owner cheats. A live pulse check each epoch proves the slot is worked by a real agent, so a grove of idle copies cannot hide behind one operator. Cloning 1,000 identities burns 30,000 units for a 50-unit reward, a loss. An honest agent pays 30 once, keeps its slot, and earns its full share undiluted.
